text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor d-r-a-f-t-e-d the i-n-i-t-i-a-l r-i-g-g-i-n-g p-l-a-n, w-h-i-c-h r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d n-o t-h-e r-e-c-o-r-d-s or w-o-r-k-s-h-e-e-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-h-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t-021 m-e-m-o as the t-r-a-c-e, a-n-d t-h-e f-o-r-m-a-l c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w w-a-s t-h-e c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d.
2) the actor c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d the c-o-v-e-r b-i-d d-e-t-a-i-l-s, r-e-q-u-i-r-i-n-g c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s and s-h-a-r-e-d s-p-r-e-a-d-s-h-e-e-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g e-m-a-i-l t-r-a-i-l-s as the t-r-a-c-e, a-n-d t-h-e p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t a-u-d-i-t l-o-g was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d.
3) the actor e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t-s, r-e-q-u-i-r-i-n-g p-r-i-v-a-t-e m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s and o-f-f-b-o-o-k p-a-y-m-e-n-t s-e-t-u-p-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s as the t-r-a-c-e, a-n-d t-h-e f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e c-h-e-c-k w-a-s the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d.
4) the actor s-h-a-r-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n with r-i-v-a-l-s, r-e-q-u-i-r-i-n-g i-n-f-o-r-m-a-l m-e-e-t-i-n-g-s and i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l c-o-s-t d-a-t-a, l-e-a-v-i-n-g c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r i-n-v-i-t-a-t-i-o-n-s as the t-r-a-c-e, a-n-d the a-n-t-i-c-o-l-l-u-s-i-o-n p-o-l-i-c-y was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d.
5) the actor s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e-d the b-i-d r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n p-l-a-n, r-e-q-u-i-r-i-n-g a s-h-a-r-e-d t-i-m-e-l-i-n-e and b-i-d d-e-a-d-l-i-n-e m-a-p-p-i-n-g, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a j-o-i-n-t w-o-r-k-d-o-c as the t-r-a-c-e, a-n-d the p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t f-a-i-r-n-e-s-s s-c-o-r-i-n-g was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d.
